summary:
Astronauts going to the Moon or Mars will never have immediate access to a doctor. Due to the vast distances between Earth and the Moon/Mars, astronauts won’t be able to wait for 20 minutes to contact Mission Control to ask if any strange symptoms are serious.
Astria was developed as a medical co-pilot for astronauts to help them take care of themselves on deep space journeys. Based on real data from NASA’s Human Research Program, Astria monitors the top 17 health risks astronauts face during their mission such as vision problems and lack of sleep. Rather than providing crews with complex medical charts, Astria has a simple 3D scanning body and eye test. Astria will walk crew members through a simple triage process if anything seems wrong.
details: The project works using NASA's data and a chat bot that guides the astronauts. The intent of this project is for astronauts to be able to survive in space by themselves without send messages back to earth. We used c++ and AI to complete the project. I think this project is creative be cause we have a special feature that helps astronauts fix their vision after they go into 0 gravity
